assumptions: Board is always 4x4 with the classic 2048 palette and gray frame/empty cells.
Board region is the largest near-square gray-frame component; refined by row/column coverage when the coarse box overshoots.
Tile values are inferred from median tile background color matched to the scaled palette.
Swipes across the board center move all tiles; distance ~32% of board size each way.
limitations: No OCR: values beyond 2048 or recolored themes may be labeled unknown.
Cannot distinguish mid-animation frames reliably; transient frames may be labeled unknown and rejected.
No game-over detection beyond 'no direction changes the board'.
